analysis: Implements a GPU-free standard-library validator for four-discrete-GPU capacity receipts.
Counts physical participants only after canonical ID, physical alias, and root/subdevice alias deduplication.
Requires one successful four-device receipt plus matching single-device and three-device allocator-OOM attempts with clean controller state.
Rejects replicated shards, non-VRAM residency, stale telemetry, missing peaks, numeric tolerance violations, and mismatched hashed bindings.
prerequisites: ROOT must set CANDIDATE_PATH or CANDIDATE_SOURCE_PATH to the actual candidate source path before running tests_source.
Trusted artifact hashes and receipt metadata must be supplied by ROOT or another external authority; trusted=True is not self-certified.
Tests import the candidate from disk and do not embed duplicate source.
evidence_limits: PASS cannot be inferred from advertised memory, planned budgets, driver memory deltas, tiny fixtures, or shared iGPU arithmetic.
Unknown allocator class, residency backing, physical alias, missing peaks, or stale telemetry returns NOT_CHECKED exit2.
Confounded controller state, replicated shards, non-discrete devices, failed numeric checks, or mismatched bindings return FAIL exit1.
This validator checks receipt semantics only; it does not prove physical P2P, reverse visibility, or hardware capacity by itself.
references: CUDA Driver API memory management: cuMemGetHandleForAddressRange DMA_BUF export constraints.
Level Zero programming guide: ze_external_memory_import_fd_t with ZE_EXTERNAL_MEMORY_TYPE_FLAG_DMA_BUF.
CUDA external interop: DMABUF import limited to Tegra Thor; no desktop Intel-export import proof.
Level Zero device/peer documentation and Intel Platform Evaluation Guide for multi-ARC, scoped to documentation.
